messages:
maria: Heads up — US-W2 warmup latency spiked after the regional VPC lockdown cut traffic to the keystore privatelink. GPUs are sitting in 'booting' for 30-60s instead of ~5s. Errors show KMS decrypt retries and conntrack resets.

devin: any recent ACL changes?

maria: yes, infra rolled the strict egress policy at 02:10 UTC. firewall rule id fw-6632 now denies 10.0.0.0/16 -> privatelink. logs:

```
ERROR: keystore-decrypt: timed out after 1000ms; retry 3/3
WARN: conntrack: close conn to 10.0.5.12:4489 reset by policy
```

sasha: omg, that explains the sudden warmpool misses. nodes can't fetch secrets quickly so bootstrap stalls.

liam: ops-bot created INC-8721 and marked as sev-3. @infra can we get a temporary allowlist for keystore traffic from the warmpool subnets?

ops-bot: Incident INC-8721 created by liam — assigned: infra-oncall, eta: 2h

emily: batching KMS requests won't help for boot since each node needs its own identity. Short term we can:
- add firewall exception for 10.0.5.0/24 -> privatelink
- increase warmpool target by 20% (cost ~+$950/day)
- failover GPU joins to us-east-1 (capacity constraints)

devin: I'd prefer exception + audit flagging. We need audit logs later for compliance review. Any acceptance from security?

maria: Security asked for justification; we'll capture all keystore audit lines and send to retention for the next 14 days. Also propose an egress-rule TTL: allowlist only for 3 hours then auto-expire.

sasha: tl;dr: temporary allowlist + capture audit, scale warmpool if joins continue. Who owns the firewall change?

liam: infra-oncall will push the rule now. I'll also run a rolling restart test on staging to confirm gap closes.

emily: measure — watch warmup metric: gpu.node_boot_time_p95; tag the deploy with incident id.

devin: remind to include cost delta in the incident summary. Security will want it.

maria: thanks. pushing step: 1) infra allowlist 10.0.5.0/24 -> privatelink (in flight) 2) enable audit retention for keystore (14d) 3) monitor p95 and scale if >20% of joins fail in 15m.

sasha: adding runbook note: if we see KMS 403/429 spike, fallback to pre-warmed cached keys for new nodes for up to 60s.

liam: rule in prod in 4m, I'll report back with timestamps.

ops-bot: INC-8721 update: rule applied at 1709876602, infra-oncall claimed.

maria: post-change p95 down to 6s within 90s. keeping monitor until EOD. filing postmortem with cost + compliance items.

emily: nice. add to next security review: consider keystore regional mirrors to avoid single privatelink dependency.

devin: closing loop — thanks everyone :thumbsup:
